主要内容: On May 16, 2013, DISH Network Corporation announced that its wholly-owned subsidiary, DISH DBS Corporation, priced $1.25 billion aggregate principal amount of 4-year, 5% Senior Notes due 2017. DISH Network also issued $1.35 billion in 10-year, 6.25% Senior Notes due 2023. The Notes will mature on May 15, 2023. Interest will be paid on May 15 and November 15 of each year, starting November 15, 2013. The net proceeds will be placed into escrow to finance a portion of the cash consideration for DISH Network’s proposed merger with Sprint Nextel Corporation. If DISH Network does not acquire or merge with Sprint, or if the cash consideration is less than $2.6 billion, DISH DBS will be required to redeem all of the Notes. The Notes were issued in a private placement under Rule 144A and Regulation S. They have not been registered under the Securities Act and may not be offered or sold in the United States without registration or an exemption.
